meta.title: Enable pull request trigger tests
meta.body_summary: Enable previously skipped pull request trigger tests by mocking network calls and adding conditional diff fetching to avoid unnecessary API calls when 'diff' accessor is not requested.

perf_labels.notes: Small fix adding accessor check to skip unnecessary diff fetches; merged quickly with one human approval and no benchmark requirement.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 39 changed lines across 2 files, this is a tiny edit by absolute volume. It fits a minimal performance optimization that merged quickly without friction.

review_details.concern_detail: Human reviewer shige approved with a thank-you emoji; bots provided non-blocking suggestions. No critical concerns raised.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid unnecessary getPullRequestDiff API calls when output accessor is not 'diff'.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: A simple conditional check to skip API calls falls within agent capability; no evidence or deep integration required.

detection_detail.code_reading: shige reviewed and approved without comment except a thank-you; bot reviewers also read code and did not flag blocking issues.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or timing data provided; PR just enables tests and adds conditional logic.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression introduced; the change is a performance improvement without causing issues.

core_change_summary.description: In trigger-utils.ts, added if (args.output.accessor !== payload) continue; before calling getPullRequestDiff to skip unnecessary API calls when diff is not requested. In trigger-utils.test.ts, enabled previously skipped test suites and improved mocks with repository node IDs and diff hunks.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Only these two files changed; no secondary observability modifications.
change_trajectory: Single commit 'test: enable pull request trigger suites' adds the conditional check and test modifications together.
